description: Repeatable monitoring of new scholarly publications with explicit queries, stable deduplication, checkpoints, and source-linked update digests.

rules.reason: The researcher wants a repeatable update and deduplication workflow for new publications.

interface.short_description: Track new publications without losing the evidence trail.

interface.default_prompt: Set up a reproducible publication monitor for this topic.
